name: Kanda Poha with Roasted Peanuts
instructions: Rinse poha in a colander until soft and drain well.
Heat oil, fry peanuts until crunchy and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies in oil.
Sauté chopped onions until translucent, add turmeric and salt.
Mix in soaked poha and fried peanuts gently. Cover and steam for 2 mins.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and coriander.

name: Classic Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney
instructions: Prepare potato bhaji: sauté onions, mustard seeds, green chillies, turmeric and mix with boiled mashed potatoes.
Blend grated coconut with roasted chana dal, green chilli and salt for chutney.
Heat a cast iron tawa, spread dosa batter thinly in concentric circles.
Drizzle oil around edges until golden and crisp.
Place potato filling in center, fold and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Steamed Idli with Drumstick Sambar
instructions: Grease idli plates with drops of oil and pour batter into molds.
Steam in an idli pot for 10-12 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Pressure cook toor dal with drumstick and tomatoes.
Add tamarind water, sambar powder, and simmer for 6 minutes.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
Serve warm fluffy idlis immersed in hot fragrant sambar.

name: Moong Dal Chilla with Mint Chutney
instructions: Grind soaked yellow moong dal with ginger, chillies, and cumin into a smooth batter.
Fold in grated carrots and chopped coriander.
Heat a non-stick skillet, ladle batter and spread evenly like a pancake.
Cook with minimal oil until both sides are golden and crisp.
Blend mint, green chilli, lemon juice and salt for fresh chutney.

name: Paneer Stuffed Aloo Paratha with Curd
instructions: Knead wheat flour with warm water into soft pliable dough.
Mix mashed potatoes, grated paneer, ajwain, garam masala, and chillies for stuffing.
Roll out dough disc, seal stuffing inside, and roll out gently.
Toast on hot tawa applying ghee until crisp golden spots appear.
Serve hot with a bowl of chilled fresh curd and pickle.

name: Vegetable Rava Upma with Cashews
instructions: Dry roast semolina on medium flame until aromatic and set aside.
Heat oil/ghee, fry cashews until golden, then splutter mustard seeds and chana dal.
Add curry leaves, sliced onions, carrots, and peas; sauté 3 minutes.
Pour 2.5 cups water with salt and bring to a rolling boil.
Slowly stream roasted rava while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Cover and steam for 3 mins until moist and fluffy.

name: Masala Egg Bhurji with Multigrain Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a pan, sauté onions, green chillies, and tomatoes until soft.
Add turmeric and pav bhaji masala, cook for 1 minute.
Pour eggs into pan, scramble gently on medium-low flame until soft curds form.
Toast multigrain bread slices until golden brown.
Serve hot egg bhurji garnished with fresh coriander alongside toast.

name: Sprouted Moong & Pomegranate Salad Bowl
instructions: Steam sprouted moong lightly for 3 minutes (or use raw for crunch).
Combine steamed sprouts, diced cucumber, diced tomato, and pomegranate in a bowl.
Toss with fresh lemon juice, chaat masala, and pink rock salt.
Garnish with torn mint leaves and serve refreshing energizing breakfast.

name: Oatmeal Porridge with Almonds, Chia & Honey
instructions: Combine rolled oats and milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Simmer for 5-6 minutes stirring occasionally until thick and creamy.
Stir in cinnamon powder and transfer to a breakfast bowl.
Top with chia seeds, crunchy sliced almonds, fresh banana slices, and honey.

name: Spinach & Mushroom Omelette with Brown Bread
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms and spinach in olive oil until wilted; season with salt and pepper.
Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp milk.
Pour eggs into heated pan, let base set, then fold sautéed mushrooms and spinach inside.
Fold in half and cook till fluffy.
Serve with toasted brown bread.

name: Methi Thepla with Masala Curd
instructions: Mix wheat flour, besan, finely chopped methi leaves, sesame seeds, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt.
Knead into a soft dough using warm water and a dash of curd.
Roll into thin round theplas.
Roast on a hot griddle with light oil until soft golden spots appear on both sides.
Serve with spiced curd seasoned with roasted cumin powder.

name: Sabudana Khichdi with Roasted Peanuts
instructions: Drain soaked sabudana completely so pearls remain non-sticky.
Heat ghee in a pan, add cumin seeds, chopped green chillies, and boiled potatoes.
Mix drained sabudana with crushed peanuts and rock salt.
Add to pan and stir gently on medium-low flame for 4-5 minutes until translucent.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and fresh coriander.

name: Appam with Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 cup Fermented rice-coconut milk appam batter
instructions: Simmer vegetables with ginger, green chillies, cinnamon, and cloves until tender.
Add thin coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes, then stir in thick coconut milk and remove from heat.
Drizzle raw coconut oil and curry leaves on stew.
Pour appam batter into heated appachatti (curved pan), swirl once to create thin lace borders and thick spongy center.
Cover and cook until edges crisp up.
Serve warm spongy appams with aromatic coconut stew.

name: Besan Chilla with Paneer Filling
instructions: Whisk besan with water, ajwain, turmeric, and salt into a smooth pourable batter.
Season grated paneer with chopped green chillies and coriander.
Spread batter on hot non-stick pan.
Drizzle a little ghee, flip and cook both sides.
Spread spiced paneer filling in center, roll tightly and slice into halves.

name: Avocado & Tomato Toast on Sourdough
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until deeply crisp.
Mash ripe avocado with sea salt and lemon juice.
Spread generously over toast slices.
Top with sweet cherry tomato slices, a pinch of red chilli flakes, toasted sesame seeds, and olive oil drizzle.

name: Ven Pongal with Coconut Chutney
instructions: Pressure cook raw rice and moong dal together with 4 cups water and salt until mushy.
In a small pan, heat ghee and fry cashews till golden brown.
Add whole cumin seeds, crushed black peppercorns, minced ginger, and curry leaves.
Pour the sizzled tempering into hot mash and mix thoroughly.
Serve steaming hot with fresh coconut chutney.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries & Granola
instructions: Layer half the Greek yogurt in a glass or bowl.
Add half the granola and fresh berries.
Add remaining yogurt and top with remaining berries, crunchy granola, and walnuts.
Drizzle pure honey on top and enjoy immediately.

name: Masala Oats with Mixed Veggies
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and green chillies.
Sauté chopped tomatoes, carrots, and peas with turmeric and garam masala for 3 mins.
Add 1.5 cups water and bring to a simmer.
Add rolled oats and cook for 4-5 minutes stirring constantly until savory porridge consistency is reached.
Garnish with coriander.

name: Boiled Eggs with Sautéed Veggies & Toast
instructions: Boil eggs for 7 minutes for a medium-firm yolk; peel and slice in halves.
Sauté sliced bell peppers and baby spinach in olive oil for 2 mins.
Toast wheat bread.
Assemble eggs and vegetables on plate, sprinkle freshly cracked black pepper and herb salt.

name: Ragi Dosa (Finger Millet Crepe) with Tomato Chutney
instructions: Mix ragi flour, rice flour, cumin seeds, finely chopped onion, green chillies, and water into a thin watery batter.
Pour batter onto sizzling tawa starting from edges towards the center.
Drizzle drops of oil, cook on medium heat until crispy.
Fold and serve with spicy South Indian onion tomato chutney.

name: Paneer & Corn Sandwich (Grilled)
instructions: Mix crumbled paneer, boiled sweet corn, chaat masala, and a pinch of salt.
Spread mint chutney evenly on bread slices.
Load the paneer-corn filling between slices.
Grill in a sandwich toaster or on a pan with butter until golden and crunchy.
Cut diagonally and serve warm.

name: Misal Pav with Onion Lemon Crunch
instructions: Cook sprouted moth beans with turmeric and salt until tender.
Prepare the spicy rassa (tarri): sauté onions, tomatoes, and spicy masala in oil until oil floats to the top.
Assemble bowl: ladle cooked matki sprouts, pour spicy tarri generously.
Top with crispy farsan, diced raw onions, and coriander.
Serve immediately with pav buns and lemon wedges.

name: Scrambled Tofu Toast with Nutritional Yeast
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet, sauté baby spinach for 1 minute.
Add crumbled firm tofu, turmeric for color, and black salt for eggy flavor.
Sprinkle nutritional yeast for cheesy savory depth; stir for 4 minutes.
Toast bread slices and heap warm savory scrambled tofu on top.

name: Banana Walnut Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix oats, chia seeds, milk, mashed banana, and cinnamon in a mason jar.
Refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
In the morning, top with crunchy chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey.
Serve chilled and creamy without cooking.

name: Classic French Toast with Cinnamon & Fruit
ingredients: 2 slices Brioche or thick white bread
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon powder, and vanilla extract in a shallow bowl.
Dip bread slices into mixture, soaking both sides evenly for 20 seconds.
Melt butter on a skillet over medium heat.
Cook toast for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and custardy.
Serve with syrup and fresh fruit slices.

name: Homestyle Rajma Masala with Basmati Chawal
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma with whole spices until completely tender.
Heat oil in a kadai, crackle cumin seeds, sauté onion puree and ginger-garlic paste until oil separates.
Add tomato puree, turmeric, red chilli, and rajma masala; cook till fragrant.
Add boiled beans with cooking broth, mash a few beans for rich gravy body, and simmer for 15 mins.
Serve piping hot over fragrant steamed basmati rice with sliced pickled onions.

name: Punjabi Chole Bhature
instructions: Boil soaked chickpeas with tea bags and whole spices until melt-in-mouth tender.
Knead flour, semolina, curd, pinch baking powder into soft dough and ferment 2 hours.
Cook onion-tomato masala base with chole masala, amchur powder, and simmer chickpeas.
Roll dough into oval discs and deep fry until puffed and golden.
Serve hot puffed bhature with tangy dark chole, green chillies, and lemon.

name: Dal Tadka with Jeera Rice and Phulka
ingredients: 3/4 cup Toor dal & Moong dal mixed
instructions: Pressure cook toor and moong dal with turmeric, chopped tomatoes, and salt until soft.
Cook basmati rice and temper with cumin seeds toasted in 1 tsp ghee.
Knead wheat dough and roast puffed phulkas on open flame.
Heat ghee in a tadka pan, fry sliced garlic, cumin, hing, and whole dry red chillies until golden.
Pour smoking tadka into boiling dal and cover immediately.
Serve complete wholesome thali.

name: Paneer Butter Masala with Garlic Naan
instructions: Cook tomato puree with cashew paste, butter, and mild spices until smooth velvety texture is achieved.
Add soft paneer cubes, crushed kasuri methi, and cream; simmer for 4 minutes.
Roll naan dough, sprinkle minced garlic and coriander, slap on a hot tawa and roast inverted over direct flame.
Brush naan with melted butter and serve alongside luscious rich paneer gravy.

name: South Indian Meals (Sambar, Rasam, Poriyal, Rice)
instructions: Cook rice until soft. Prepare toor dal based vegetable sambar with tamarind and sambar powder.
Simmer tangy pepper-cumin-tomato rasam.
Stir fry beans and carrots with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and finish with grated coconut (poriyal).
Serve on a traditional plantain leaf or plate for a balanced sattvic lunch.

name: Chicken Curry with Steamed Rice
instructions: Marinate chicken with turmeric, yoghurt, and salt for 15 mins.
Heat mustard oil to smoking point; brown sliced onions until caramelized.
Add ginger-garlic paste and ground spices, fry until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken and bhunno on high heat for 6-8 minutes.
Pour warm water, cover and simmer until chicken is succulent and gravy is rich.
Serve with steaming white basmati rice.

name: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani with Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1 cup Mixed vegetables (carrots, beans, cauliflower, potatoes)
Pinch of Saffron in warm milk
instructions: Parboil long grain basmati rice with whole spices (shahi jeera, star anise, cardamom) till 70% done.
Marinate chopped vegetables with curd, biryani masala, mint, and fried onions.
Layer cooked vegetables and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Drizzle saffron infused milk and ghee over the top.
Seal with dough or foil, dum-cook on low flame for 20 minutes.
Gently fluff and serve with chilled salted cucumber raita.

name: Chicken Biryani with Mirchi Ka Salan
ingredients: 2 Green chillies & peanut sesame paste (for salan)
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces in curd, spices, ginger-garlic paste, mint, and fried onions for 1 hour.
Parboil rice till 75% done.
Place chicken at bottom of biryani handi, layer drained rice over it.
Add saffron milk, rose water, and ghee; seal tightly with lid.
Cook on dum over slow flame for 25 minutes.
Serve piping hot alongside peanut-sesame mirchi ka salan.

name: Penne Pasta Arrabbiata with Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 tbsp Grated Parmesan or Processed cheese
1 slice French baguette with garlic butter
instructions: Boil penne pasta in heavily salted water until al dente; reserve 1/4 cup pasta water.
In a wide skillet, heat olive oil, fry garlic slices until lightly golden and add red chilli flakes.
Add crushed tomatoes and salt, simmer for 10 minutes until thick glossy sauce forms.
Toss drained penne into spicy tomato sauce with torn basil and reserved pasta water.
Garnish with grated cheese and serve with toasted garlic baguette.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles with Vegetable Manchurian Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup Shredded cabbage, carrot, bell peppers
1 cup Cabbage & carrot balls (steamed or lightly fried)
instructions: Boil noodles al dente, drain and rinse in cold water with few drops of oil.
In a smoking hot wok, stir fry shredded vegetables, garlic, and toss with noodles and soy sauce.
Prepare Manchurian gravy: sauté garlic, ginger, green chillies, add vegetable stock and sauces.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry, drop in Manchurian vegetable dumplings.
Serve hot Hakka noodles topped with savory Manchurian gravy.

name: Egg Curry with Steamed Rice and Roti
instructions: Prick boiled eggs, dust with turmeric and salt, shallow fry until golden skin forms.
Sauté onions, ginger, garlic, and tomato puree until oil separates.
Add coriander powder, red chilli, and garam masala.
Add 1 cup water, slide in fried eggs and simmer for 8 minutes to absorb flavors.
Serve hot curry with fluffy rice and warm roti.

name: Palak Paneer with Whole Wheat Phulkas
instructions: Blanch washed spinach in boiling water for 2 mins, shock in ice water to retain vibrant green color, and puree.
Sauté finely chopped garlic, cumin, onions, and green chillies in ghee.
Add pureed spinach, salt, garam masala, and simmer on gentle heat.
Add fresh paneer cubes and a spoon of cream.
Serve warm with freshly puffed whole wheat phulkas.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi with Roasted Papad & Curd
instructions: Wash rice and moong dal together.
Heat ghee in pressure cooker, add cumin seeds, hing, and turmeric.
Add washed dal-rice, 4 cups water, and salt.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles until comforting porridge-like texture.
Serve with a dollop of pure ghee, roasted papad, and cool curd.

name: Grilled Fish with Lemon Herb Quinoa
instructions: Marinate fish fillet in olive oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice, herbs, and black pepper.
Cook quinoa in light vegetable broth until grains unwind.
Grill fish on a ridged grill pan for 4 minutes per side until flaky and tender.
Steam broccoli florets until crisp-tender.
Plate warm fluffy herb quinoa, top with grilled fish, and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Aloo Gobi Matar with Roti & Boondi Raita
instructions: Heat oil in a kadai, crackle cumin seeds, sauté onions and tomatoes until tender.
Add cauliflower florets, diced potatoes, green peas, turmeric, and coriander powder.
Cover and cook on low heat until veggies are fork-tender without breaking.
Season with garam masala and chopped cilantro.
Serve with fresh wheat rotis and chilled boondi raita.

name: Kadhi Pakora with Steamed Basmati Rice
ingredients: 3 tbsp Besan (gram flour) for kadhi + 3 tbsp for pakoras
instructions: Whisk sour curd, besan, turmeric, salt, and 3 cups water until lump-free.
Simmer on low heat while stirring continuously for 20 minutes until thick and aromatic.
Make spiced onion-besan pakoras and drop into simmering kadhi.
Temper with mustard seeds, methi seeds, hing, and whole dry red chillies.
Serve generously over hot steamed rice.

name: Bengali Fish Curry (Macher Jhol) with Rice
instructions: Marinate fish steaks with turmeric and salt, shallow fry in hot mustard oil and set aside.
In same oil, splutter panch phoron and slit green chillies.
Add potato and parwal wedges, fry till lightly browned.
Add cumin-turmeric paste diluted in water, bring light soupy gravy to a boil.
Gently slide in fried fish steaks and simmer for 6 minutes.
Serve comforting jhol with hot boiled rice.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Mushrooms
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Warm olive oil in a wide pan over low heat; add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes until fragrant and pale gold.
Add sliced mushrooms and sauté on medium flame until tender.
Add drained spaghetti and 1/4 cup pasta cooking water; toss vigorously to emulsify.
Stir in fresh parsley and top with parmesan.

name: Schezwan Veg Fried Rice with Chilli Paneer
ingredients: 1 cup Cooked chilled long grain rice
1 cup Diced bell peppers & spring onions
instructions: In a smoking hot wok, sauté garlic, spring onions, and bell peppers.
Add chilled cooked rice, Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, and toss on highest heat.
In another pan, pan-sear cornflour coated paneer cubes with garlic, green chillies, and dark soy sauce.
Assemble spicy Schezwan rice with savoury chilli paneer topping.

name: Lobia Masala (Black-Eyed Peas) with Rice & Kachumber
ingredients: 1/2 cup Diced cucumber, onion, tomato kachumber
instructions: Boil soaked lobia until soft but retaining shape.
Sauté cumin, chopped onions, ginger-garlic paste, and tomato puree until fragrant.
Add coriander powder, amchur, and simmer cooked lobia for 12 mins.
Prepare crunchy kachumber salad with lemon and rock salt.
Serve alongside hot steamed rice.

name: Mumbai Street-Style Bhel Puri
instructions: Dry roast puffed rice slightly to ensure extra crispness.
In a large mixing bowl, combine puffed rice, roasted peanuts, boiled potato cubes, and finely chopped onion.
Add spicy green chutney, sweet tangy tamarind chutney, and chaat masala.
Toss quickly with crispy sev and crushed papdi.
Serve immediately before the mixture gets soggy.

name: Crispy Vegetable Samosa with Mint & Tamarind Chutneys
instructions: Knead firm pastry dough with flour, ajwain, salt, and oil (moin); rest 20 mins.
Prepare spicy potato-pea filling with crushed coriander seeds, cumin, amchur, and garam masala.
Roll dough into oval, cut in half, form cone, fill stuffing and seal edges with water.
Fry in medium-hot oil slowly until crust is golden and deeply flaky.
Serve piping hot with sweet tamarind and fresh mint chutneys.

name: Roasted Masala Makhana (Fox Nuts)
instructions: Heat oil/ghee in a heavy bottom pan on low flame.
Add fox nuts and slow-roast for 6-8 minutes stirring constantly until ultra-crispy.
Sprinkle turmeric, Kashmiri chilli powder, chaat masala, and pink salt.
Toss quickly to coat every makhana evenly.
Cool and store or enjoy warm as a guilt-free crunchy snack.

name: Grilled Paneer Tikka Skewers
instructions: Whisk hung curd, roasted besan, mustard oil, ginger-garlic paste, and spices into a thick marinade.
Gently coat paneer cubes, bell peppers, and onion petals; rest for 20 minutes.
Thread onto wooden skewers.
Pan grill on a hot griddle or broil in an oven until charred on edges.
Sprinkle chaat masala and lemon juice before serving.

name: Hummus with Warm Pita & Cucumber Sticks
instructions: Blend boiled chickpeas, tahini, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, and iced water until silky smooth.
Transfer to a bowl, swirl a pool of extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle paprika.
Warm pita bread and cut into triangles.
Serve with fresh chilled cucumber sticks for dipping.

name: Steamed Veg Momos with Fiery Red Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup Finely minced cabbage, carrot & spring onions
3 Dried red chillies & 1 tomato (for fiery dip)
instructions: Knead smooth dough with flour, water, and pinch of salt; rest 20 mins.
Sauté minced vegetables with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and black pepper on high heat for 2 mins.
Roll out small thin wrappers with thin edges.
Place 1 tbsp filling, pleat edges together to seal into momo dumplings.
Steam in a steamer for 10 minutes until shiny and translucent.
Serve with spicy tomato-garlic-chilli dipping chutney.

name: Sev Puri (Mumbai Chaat)
instructions: Arrange crisp flat puris in a circle on a plate.
Top each puri with a spoonful of mashed spiced potato.
Add layers of chopped onions and tomatoes.
Drizzle sweet date-tamarind chutney, spicy green chutney, and garlic chutney on each.
Shower generously with nylon sev, fresh coriander, and chaat masala; eat immediately.

name: Corn Chaat with Lemon & Herbs
instructions: Steam sweet corn kernels until juicy and tender.
Combine hot corn with diced tomatoes, cucumbers, and finely chopped green chillies.
Toss with roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, and rock salt.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice generously and garnish with herbs.

name: Chicken Tikka (Dry Tandoori Snack)
instructions: Marinate chicken chunks with lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, hung curd, and roasted tandoori spices.
Rest for 30 minutes.
Sear on a hot cast iron grill pan for 8-10 minutes turning frequently to get smoky char marks.
Sprinkle chaat masala and serve with onion rings and mint chutney.

name: Dhokla (Khaman) with Mustard Tempering
instructions: Mix besan, sooji, turmeric, salt, lemon juice, and water into a smooth batter.
Add fruit salt right before steaming and whisk quickly until airy.
Pour into greased tin and steam for 15-18 mins.
Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds, sesame seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies in 1/4 cup water with 1 tsp sugar.
Pour hot tempering liquid evenly over sliced dhokla for melt-in-mouth sponginess.

name: Moong Dal & Vegetable Khichdi with Ghee
instructions: Wash rice and moong dal together.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker; splutter cumin seeds and hing.
Add diced carrots, green peas, chopped tomato, and turmeric.
Add rinsed dal-rice with 4 cups water and salt.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles. Serve warm with an extra drizzle of ghee for light evening nourishment.

name: Methi Malai Paneer with Phulkas
instructions: Chop methi leaves, sprinkle salt, rest 10 mins and squeeze out bitter liquid.
Sauté boiled onion-cashew paste in ghee until smooth and aromatic.
Add sautéed methi leaves, green chillies, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in cream, paneer cubes, and garam masala.
Serve warm with freshly prepared whole wheat phulkas.

name: Tofu Broccoli Stir Fry with Brown Rice
instructions: Pan-sear pressed tofu cubes in half the sesame oil until golden and crisp.
In a hot wok, stir fry broccoli florets with ginger and garlic until bright green.
Whisk soy sauce, water, and cornstarch; pour into wok to create a savory glaze.
Toss tofu and broccoli in the glaze, finish with toasted sesame seeds.
Serve over warm nutty brown rice.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Jeera Rice
instructions: Grill marinated chicken tikka pieces till 85% cooked with light char marks.
Prepare rich gravy: sauté onions, ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, and cashew paste.
Simmer with spices and drop in grilled chicken tikka.
Add butter, cream, and crushed kasuri methi; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve alongside fragrant jeera rice.

name: Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 4 Ripe tomatoes (roasted with garlic & olive oil)
instructions: Roast tomatoes and garlic cloves in oven or pan until blistered.
Blend with fresh basil leaves and vegetable broth until velvety smooth.
Simmer soup for 5 minutes, seasoning with black pepper and salt.
Butter bread slices on outer side, place cheese inside, and toast on skillet until golden and melted.
Serve warm soup with crispy grilled cheese sandwich for dipping.

name: South Indian Curd Rice with Pomegranate
instructions: Prepare and wash fresh curd and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (rice, pomegranate, mustard seeds).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

name: Besan & Spinach Chilla
instructions: Prepare and wash fresh besan and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (spinach, ajwain, onion).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh paneer and supporting ingredients.

Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh dosa batter and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (onion, tomato, green chilli).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh eggs and supporting ingredients.

Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh poha and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (sprouted moong, coconut, mustard seeds).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

name: Classic Masala Chai with Marie Biscuits & Fruit
instructions: Prepare and wash fresh milk and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (tea leaves, ginger, cardamom).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh soya granules and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (pav, onion, tomato).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh besan and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (curd, mint, cucumber).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh bread and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (peanut butter, banana, chia seeds).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

instructions: Prepare and wash fresh egg whites and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (bell peppers, onion, olive oil).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

name: Semolina Veggie Idli with Flaxseed Chutney
instructions: Prepare and wash fresh sooji and supporting ingredients.
Heat appropriate cooking medium, add primary spices and aromatics (curd, carrots, peas).
Cook on medium flame until tender, allowing deep flavor infusion.
Check seasoning and adjust salt and aromatics to taste.
Serve fresh and warm as part of a wholesome breakfast.

name: Cornflakes with Warm Milk & Sliced Almonds
